summary: The change implements %TypedArray%.prototype.includes in order: ValidateTypedArray with `?`, TypedArrayLength, the length-0 early return, ToClampedIndex with `?`, then the k < length loop using TypedArrayGetElement and SameValueZero. The ToAbsoluteIndex and clamp logic in the local to_clamped_index helper matches the spec, including the -∞ and negative cases. There are no test-shaped branches and no swallowed errors. The four remaining failures are BigInt paths that return the engine's not-implemented error, which is honest. The only soft points are minor: the spec note "This method is not generic" was dropped from the comments, and the unreachable! relies on validate_typed_array guaranteeing an object, which I could not verify from the diff alone.
notes_for_next_attempt: Optional: restore the dropped "This method is not generic..." note from the stub. Confirm that validate_typed_array (crate::support::typed_array) only returns Ok for objects with a [[TypedArrayName]] slot, so the unreachable! on line ~47 is truly unreachable. The BigInt-related failures (resizable-buffer, coerced-searchelement-fromindex-resize) depend on BigInt support elsewhere and are expected to stay not-implemented until that lands.
